record.title: Evaluate factory UART compatibility and the next source qualification step
record.intent: Decide the smallest useful continuation from actual delivered-source behavior.
requirements: Compare the observed display and serial outcome with the recovered point path, keeping stock-image equivalence, emitted RF, lock, level and persistence separate and unproven unless directly observed.
Select source qualification or further controller analysis from the result; do not expand the trial to make it succeed. Keep the RF-response milestone as the objective.
Commit and push conclusions and task receipts. Perform no additional physical intervention during this decision.
acceptance: The compatibility finding and next bounded question are recorded without promoting host evidence into RF validation.
